name: B10-0529/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Escalating repression of the Baha’is in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalating repression of the Baha’is in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Iran's treatment of the Baha'i religious minority. It condemns arrests, detentions and enforced disappearances of Baha'i people, and says two thirds of imprisoned Baha'is are women. It also condemns bans on Baha'i students entering education, and the destruction of Baha'i cemeteries and funerals. The Parliament asks Iran to release all Baha'i prisoners held for their religion and stop harassment. It calls on the European Union and its member states to raise these abuses in talks with Iran and at the United Nations.

- The text asks for change; it does not change any law itself.
- It targets Iran's treatment of Baha'is, especially women and students.
- Next: European Union countries and United Nations bodies are urged to act.
